title: Smoky Chicken Curry
description: A flavorful and aromatic Indian-inspired dish featuring smoky chicken in a rich, nutty curry sauce. Serve over steamed basmati rice or with naan bread.
instructions: Heat 1 tablespoon of coconut oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the chicken to the skillet and cook until browned, about 5-6 minutes.
Remove the chicken from the skillet and set aside.
Add the remaining 1 tablespoon of coconut oil to the skillet.
Add the chopped onion to the skillet and cook until softened, about 3-4 minutes.
Add the nutty curry paste, smoky paprika, curry powder, and garam masala to the skillet.
Cook for 1-2 minutes, stirring constantly, until the spices are fragrant.
Add the chopped garden tomatoes to the skillet and cook until they start to break down, about 3-4 minutes.
Return the chicken to the skillet and stir to coat with the curry sauce.
Reduce heat to low and simmer, uncovered, for 10-15 minutes or until the chicken is cooked through.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Serve hot over steamed basmati rice or with naan bread.
